# Overview {.doc .doc-index}

## Core classes

Main classes used to build and run simulations.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [ArrivalConfig](ArrivalConfig.qmd#ambdes.ArrivalConfig) | Prepare arrival inputs for the simulation. |
| [SimConfig](SimConfig.qmd#ambdes.SimConfig) | Configuration for a simulation run. |
| [Model](Model.qmd#ambdes.Model) | Discrete-event simulation model for generating patient calls. |
| [Patient](Patient.qmd#ambdes.Patient) | Represents a patient who has called 999. |
| [Results](Results.qmd#ambdes.Results) | Simulation output for a single model run. |
| [Runner](Runner.qmd#ambdes.Runner) | Run the simulation for one or more replications. |
